title: Hydrated relation record
description: One record per line in <edition>/25_hydrated/relations.jsonl — the hydrate→tokenize inter-stage seam. Each line is one verified, faithful surface form of a 15_structured triple. This installs the proven 15_structured write-time contract at the 25_hydrated seam. relation_type's enum is NOT hardcoded here: pipeline/schema_validate._patch injects it from the domain manifest (relations.taxonomy keys when a taxonomy is declared, else the predicates keys), so the hydrated vocabulary is pinned to the SAME manifest gate_balance / gate_source_vs_gap classify relation_type against. domain=None loads this verbatim (relation_type unconstrained) — backward-compatible with the fixture tests.

text.description: the hydrated surface form — one faithful expression of the source triple

relation_type.description: the relation label. Enum injected per-domain by schema_validate._patch: taxonomy keys (EDC/Rust factory writes SEMANTIC labels, e.g. artist_to_stage) or predicate keys (generic_expand/generic_synth write the RAW predicate, e.g. made_of). Left a free string in the static schema (domain=None).

entity_ids.description: the display names/ids this line connects. Arity is domain-dependent — generic binary relations emit 2 ([subject, object]); the festival Rust factory emits 1..n (observed 1..17 in the gold, e.g. a stage roster). minItems 1, NO maxItems — arity is deliberately not over-constrained.

source_triple_ids.description: provenance back-links to the 15_structured triple(s) this line is faithful to, e.g. ["plays_at:34"].

source_doc_ids.description: Optional provenance back-links to the clean documents supporting source_triple_ids. Present only when structured triples carry doc_id provenance.

split.description: corpus split tag, e.g. cpt | qa_in_cpt.

direction.description: surface direction (order-matched augmentation), e.g. forward | reverse.

surface_form.description: how the text was produced, e.g. template | llm_synth | qa_direct | schedule_line | declarative.

query_order.description: order-matched augmentation tag (festival Rust path), e.g. leads_with_artist.

context_profile.description: disjoint-context grouping key (festival/disjoint path), e.g. shared_v4.

polarity.description: polarity tag (set-time / disjoint path), e.g. positive | negative.
